title: Faisal Town Phase 2 Sector R / Model Block – Cash Prices, Plan & Plots
description: Explore Sector R / Model Block in Faisal Town Phase 2 with full-payment availability, current listed prices, the official sector plan and WhatsApp plot checks.
h1: Faisal Town Phase 2 Sector R / Model Block
intro: Explore Sector R full-payment plot options and the updated price schedule. Available inventory has been listed from 8 Marla upward; ask us to confirm current plot numbers and the final payable amount.

body:
## Full-payment plot prices

The price schedule effective 02 November 2026 lists these sizes and discounted prices with plot number: 5.56 Marla at PKR 3,380,000, 8 Marla at PKR 4,650,000, 10.89 Marla at PKR 6,150,000, 14.22 Marla at PKR 7,690,000, 1 Kanal at PKR 10,390,000, 2 Kanal at PKR 19,990,000, 2 Kanal at PKR 21,190,000. Ask for the exact available plot number and a complete quotation before deciding.

## Sector R plan and plot location

Use the official Sector R plan to compare plot dimensions, road position and nearby open areas. Ask us to mark an available plot and share its location pin.

## Your complete quotation

The rate schedule lists PKR 20,000 registration and states that development charges are included. Ask for an itemized total for your chosen plot, including any applicable special-location charges.

## Arrange a site visit

Share your preferred size and budget. We can help you shortlist an available plot, confirm its location and arrange a site visit.
